verses.1: And Edom and Amalek answered, 'The Lord does not rule over them, the Lord of heaven and earth; in His hand is the house of His sanctuary, for they are a foreign people who do not walk in righteousness.'
verses.2: And there is no fear of God before their eyes, but rather fornication, the shedding of blood, the eating of sacrifices, violence, death, and everything like these—foolishness and error.
verses.3: They have no faith and no salt, for their deeds are evil; they do not know the Lord, and in the way of peace they do not walk, but in deceit and every unclean deed, in tumult, revelry, and wantonness, as their father Siblyanos taught them.
verses.4: For he created them together with his demons, and he teaches them every evil deed which he hates: deceit, robbery, the plundering of another's goods by violence, theft, the eating of death, violence, and fornication.
verses.5: And everything like these: adultery with another's wife, the shedding of blood, the eating of death, sacrifice to idols, the killing of a man's soul by violence, quarreling, provocation, envy, and every evil deed which does not please God. And this teaching which Siblyanos their enemy brings them, so that he may lead them astray from the way of God, the ruler of all the world.
verses.6: But to the Lord belong submission, humility, and love; righteousness and the honoring of one's brother; love and peace with all people.
verses.7: And do not be respecters of persons, nor deceivers, nor violent men, nor oppressors, nor adulterers with another's wife, nor doers of evil and injustice against your neighbor, nor violent oppressors who wrong their neighbor.
verses.8: And they quarrel and exalt themselves, and they are zealous for evil and eager to lead astray, so that they may bring men down into the judgment of the Judge forever.
